title: Creamy Eggplant Campanelle
description: Campanelle pasta is paired with tender eggplant and tart sun-dried tomatoes in a creamy sauce in this quick and easy meal.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil, or as needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.25 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, or to taste

steps.text: While the pasta is cooking, add enough olive oil to coat the bottom of a large frying pan. Heat over medium heat. Add garlic to hot oil and saute until tender, but not brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Add eggplant, salt, and pepper. Increase heat to medium-high and cook until eggplant is tender and browned, about 15 minutes.
While the eggplant is cooking, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add campanelle and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain.
Add cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk to the eggplant; stir to combine. Add more milk if necessary to make a smooth cream sauce. Add sun-dried tomatoes and cook until warmed through, 1 to 2 minutes.
Serve eggplant mixture over pasta and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
